title: S.H.E Foundation
metaTitle: SHE Foundation Brand Identity — Case Study | Santi Universe
description: S.H.E Foundation visual identity: Strength, Hope and Empowerment expressed through a profile-and-petal emblem, a colourful palette and a flexible logo family.
intro: An identity with people at its heart.

hero.alt: SHE Foundation branding concept: canvas tote, white-logo pink notebook, mug and patterned stationery on pastel display plinths
hero.caption: Brand applications · concept mockup

meta: Visual identity · Logo system · Colour & pattern

chapters.label: The identity
heading: Three words.
One expressive mark.
text: The identity brings the foundation’s name to life through three words: Strength, Hope and Empowerment. A woman’s profile sits at the centre of a colourful, petal-shaped emblem.
The final-logo presentation develops that idea into a flexible family of marks, combining the full name with compact S.H.E Foundation versions.

images.alt: Original SHE Foundation identity presentation with coloured initials and profile-and-petal emblem
images.caption: Identity presentation

chapters.label: Colour & character
heading: A palette full
of possibility.
text: Blue, pink, yellow, coral and orange give the identity a varied, expressive voice. White and dark backgrounds offer different ways to bring the colourful mark into focus.

images.alt: SHE Foundation colour palette options from the logo presentation
images.caption: Palette options

chapters.label: A flexible family
heading: Room to adapt.
Always recognisable.
text: Vertical and horizontal arrangements give the identity different proportions for different spaces. The abbreviated name provides a compact option, while the full wording makes the foundation’s name explicit.
Full-colour, white and black variations are shown together in the presentation, with the profile and petals providing a consistent visual connection.

chapters.label: Pattern & expression
heading: Beyond
the logo.
text: Diamonds, circles, lines and repeated shapes extend the identity into a decorative graphic language. The presentation explores colourful and monochrome pattern directions alongside the core mark.
Together, the logo family, palette and patterns create a foundation for consistent future communications.

chapters.label: The identity in use
heading: Made to be part
of everyday life.
text: Six concept applications explore how the logo, colour palette and geometric details can extend across merchandise, stationery and an event setting.
chapters.note: These AI-generated mockups illustrate possible brand applications, rather than items or events already produced by the foundation.
